name: OceanBNO
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 1.00). Replaced keyword guess "access-control".
rootCause: OceanBNO lost approximately $500,000 in BUSD after an exploit on July 18, 2023. The attacker repeatedly manipulated reward accounting for staked NFTs and BNO tokens due to flawed emergency withdrawal logic, draining the protocol and causing a 99% token price collapse. The emergencyWithdraw logic failed to link NFT withdrawal and reward eligibility, allowing users to reset reward debt without removing NFT stake. This flaw enabled repeated reward extraction and unauthorized value withdrawals.
